01 / Introduction

A little about my work

Grounded in a First Class Bachelor of Technology in Marketing from Accra Technical University and certified training in Salesforce administration, my work sits where commercial strategy meets practical operations.

Through hands-on experience in internal auditing, monitoring and evaluation, and teaching, I have seen how structured data, clear communication, and reliable digital workflows improve everyday decisions. Today, I channel that operational discipline into developing and testing venture concepts tailored for education, trade, and institutional trust across Ghana and Africa.

Structured academic consulting, research methodology guidance, and professional document preparation.

MEW

Education technology

My E-Workbook

Web-based learning workbooks, guided instructional videos, and progress tracking for pre-tertiary students.

Developing digital workbooks, instructional videos, quizzes and progress tracking to make structured learning resources more accessible to pre-tertiary learners in Ghana.

Current Stage & Scope Prototype in local development: Core web interface and workbook structures are being coded and tested on localhost alongside educational video series.
Problem Addressed

Many pre-tertiary learners and families lack structured, interactive revision and assessment tools that align with classroom learning outside school hours.

Intended Beneficiaries

Learners, parents, teachers and schools.

  • EdTech
  • Digital learning
  • Assessment
  • Educational access

African trade and SME innovation

NAVIX

Export-readiness concept exploring how Ghanaian agro-processing SMEs can prepare for regional markets.

An AI-assisted export-readiness concept exploring how Ghanaian agro-processing SMEs can better understand compliance and documentation requirements for regional and continental markets.

Current Stage & Scope Concept in development: Localhost UI prototype and compliance workflow mapping in progress; AI readiness assessment engine is part of the intended product roadmap.
Problem Addressed

Small and medium agro-processors face fragmented compliance information and documentation barriers when preparing to trade under regional and AfCFTA frameworks.

Intended Beneficiaries

Ghanaian agro-processing SMEs and export-support organisations.

  • SME innovation
  • Trade readiness
  • Digital tools
  • AfCFTA
